description: HydroShare is an open data portal listed in HydroShare, an online repository for hydrology data and models, published or maintained by CUAHSI HydroShare. HydroShare is the hydrology repository of CUAHSI where researchers deposit data sets, models and tools. Its subject-tag search for dams, reservoirs, stormwater, wastewater, levees, bridges, roads, hydropower and similar terms returned 449 public resources; those whose subject is an infrastructure asset or system are catalogued as records of their own, and monitoring series, ecology and ... Coverage: mostly United States; some global and other countries. 449 datasets are listed in the catalogue that this harvest read; 76 of them are about infrastructure and became records of their own. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is set per dataset on the portal. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hydroshare-infrastructure-resources.
